Renekton.gap_summary: Q self-heal IS modeled: Renekton is in healing.py HEALING_RULE_CHAMPIONS (Q 'Champion Healing' 12-44 + 17% bonus AD per enemy, capped). Concerns: (1) W packet sources 'Physical Damage Per Hit' (5-65 + 75% AD) and emits a single strike, but the wiki 'Total Physical Damage' (10-130 + 150% AD) covers two strikes (three when empowered) — W is understated ~2x; (2) P fury/empower system (50-fury empowered Q/W) is declared no_damage, so empowered W (shield-destroy, longer stun) and tripled Q heal are not expressed; (3) R's fury buff/transform is modeled as damage only.

notable_atoms: self-heal (W grey-health heal = 50-100% of damage taken)
Rengar.gap_summary: CLEAR GAP: W Battle Roar self-heal (passive stores 50% of post-mitigation damage taken as grey health; active consumes it to heal) is NOT modeled — Rengar is absent from healing.py HEALING_RULE_CHAMPIONS and no module heal handling exists. Ferocity-empowered Q (the 'Additional Physical Damage' row, 20-160 + 5% AD) is not modeled either (packet uses the base 'Bonus Physical Damage' 35-260 + 20% AD row). R stealth/leap and P bonetooth are declared out of scope.

notable_atoms: buff (P charge stacks, R1 AD buff)
Riven.gap_summary: Concern: P Runic Blade is declared no_damage with reason 'no enemy-damage formula', but the wiki DOES list a damage formula (each stack-consuming auto deals bonus physical damage = 30% : 46.76% based on level AD) — the atom file has RivenPassiveAABoost damage.basic-attack, and P's empowered-auto damage is absent from the modeled rotation. E Valor shield declared no_damage (defensive, acceptable). R1 (Blade of the Exile) AD buff not expressed — only R2 Wind Slash damage is modeled. No heal atoms.

notable_atoms: heat/overheat resource (P, 3 atoms incl. overheat attacks)
Rumble.gap_summary: The heat/overheat system (stack-transform-summon-resource.heat) and Danger Zone 50% bonus damage/shield are declared out of scope (P no_damage) — heat directly gates Rumble's damage output (danger-zone Q/E/R are +50%) and overheat disables abilities, so rotation numbers assume no heat state. W Scrap Shield (shield atoms) declared no_damage; E ammo charges not expressed. Q packet models the full-channel total (65-336.84 per level) as one hit, which is fine numerically but ignores the 3s burn timeline.

Ryze.gap_summary: All four damaging slots (Q Overload 75-155 + 55% AP + 2% bonus mana, W Rune Prison, E Spell Flux, R's Overload-boosting 'Bonus Overload Damage') are modeled via wiki_attribute. W root and R channel/blink are utility (consistent with declared scope); P Arcane Mastery flux (E spread amplification) declared out of scope. The lone heal-shield atom (RyzeWShield) traces to binary 'RyzeWShield' with generic wiki 'Shield' evidence and matches no current wiki W shield — stale binary artifact, not a real gap.

Samira.gap_summary: Concern: R Inferno Trigger packet uses 'Physical Damage Per Shot' (20-60 + 30% AD) as a single hit, but the wiki 'Total Physical Damage' is 200-600 + 300% AD across 10 shots — R is understated ~10x unless the caller manually multiplies. P style/combo system and ranged-melee reclassification declared out of scope (P no_damage); W projectile-destruction utility unmodeled (its damage is modeled). No heal/shield/transform atoms.

notable_atoms: mark (P Frozen / E Permafrost stacks, 2 atoms)
Sejuani.gap_summary: All damage slots modeled: P Icebreaker Frozen bonus magic damage (12-5.29/level packet), Q dash damage, E Permafrost burst, R Glacial Prison, and W via wiki_attribute (5-45 + 30% AP + 4% max HP — note W is marked out_of_scope in MODULE_COVERAGE even though a parser exists, i.e. uncertified generic parse). Mark-stack requirement (3 stacks) and CC are state/utility. No heal/shield/transform atoms. Note: W's second swing is not accounted for if the wiki_attribute is per-swing.

Senna.gap_summary: CLEAR GAP: Q 'Healing' (40-120 + 40% bonus AD) heals Senna herself and allies — not modeled (Senna absent from HEALING_RULE_CHAMPIONS; module only emits Q damage). R's ally/self shield unmodeled (R packet is damage-only). E stealth/camouflage and wraith-form transform declared out of scope; P soul-stack AD economy declared (P packet models only the 1-10% current-HP damage).

Seraphine.gap_summary: W heal+shield family (2 heal + 2 shield atoms) declared no_damage — Surround Sound's self/ally heal and shield are unmodeled but explicitly declared out of scope (consistent with the calculator's ally-heal posture). Q packet models only the flat 60-160 + 40% AP row; the wiki 'Maximum Enhanced Damage' (105-280 + 70% AP, +0-75% based on target's missing health — damage.execute atom) is not modeled. P note echo (double-cast) declared out of scope.

Sett.gap_summary: MODULE_COVERAGE certifies ONLY E (packet); Q/W/R are wiki_attribute parsers marked out_of_scope (uncertified generic parses). Specific concerns: (1) W Haymaker is typed damage_type 'magic' but its center-line damage is TRUE damage (wiki OTHER_DAMAGE; 'dealt true damage instead') — resistances applied wrongly; (2) W's grit term unit '% (+ 25% per 100 bonus AD) of expended Grit' is unrecognized by resolve_scaling (returns 0), so only the flat 80-160 remains; (3) W grit shield unmodeled; (4) Q 'Bonus Physical Damage' (10-50 + 1-3% max HP) is per-hit but Q empowers TWO attacks (wiki 'Total Bonus Physical Damage' = 2x) — Q understated; (5) P regen (heal-shield.health-regeneration) declared out of scope.

notable_atoms: trap (W Jack in the Box, 4 atoms)
Shaco.gap_summary: E packet models the base 'Magic Damage' row (70-170 + 80% bonus AD + 60% AP) only; the wiki 'Increased Damage' execute row (105-255 + 120% bonus AD, +50% when target below 30% max HP) is not modeled (damage.execute atom). P Backstab bonus damage declared no_damage. R clone summon/pet mechanic not expressed — the packet models the clone's death explosion damage (150-300 + 70% AP) but not the controllable clone (summon/clone atoms). Q stealth/blink declared utility (damage modeled).

P Ki Barrier shield, W Spirit's Refuge auto-block, and R Stand United shield/teleport are declared no_damage (defensive/utility — consistent scope; the module's ASSUMPTIONS state this explicitly). No heal/vamp atoms. Strong coverage.

Shyvana.gap_summary: Best-in-batch transform handling: dragon_form option gates dragon Q (3rd-cast true-damage bite), dragon E explosion, and the module models W recast damage and P Scalemail armor/MR buff. Residual gaps: W shield strength (60-140 + 12% bonus health) unmodeled; W dragon-form self-heal (60-104.71 + 4-8.47% missing health when the explosion hits a champion — heal-shield.heal atom) unmodeled — Shyvana absent from HEALING_RULE_CHAMPIONS; R bonus-health/attack-range buff not expressed (damage only).

Singed.gap_summary: Poison Trail (magic dot) and Fling damage are modeled. W Mega Adhesive (slow/root ground) and R Insanity Potion (AP/armor/MR/MS + HP&mana regen buff, 125-425 HP over the duration) are declared no_damage — the R regen-heal atom (InsanityPotion) is unmodeled but is a 25s regen buff, minor and consistent with declared scope. The damage.execute atom on Mega Adhesive is a binary naming artifact, not a real execute.

Sion.gap_summary: Q is modeled via wiki_attribute 'Maximum Base Damage Increase' (200-289%, a percentage multiplier) and marked out_of_scope in MODULE_COVERAGE — the generic extractor treats '%' units as flat values, so Q emits ~200-289 flat 'damage' instead of the wiki 'Minimum Physical Damage' (30-90 + 40-80% AD) / 'Maximum Physical Damage' (90-350 + 120-240% AD) rows; Q's charge/channel mechanic is unmodeled. E armor shred (damage.penetration atom, 20% armor reduction) unmodeled. W shield unmodeled (damage modeled). P Glory-in-Death (zombie form with on-hit bonus damage + 100% lifesteal) declared out of scope.

Sivir.gap_summary: Damage slots modeled: Q two-way Boomerang Blade (60-160 + 70% bonus AD + 60% AP) and W Ricochet bounce (0 + 20-40% AD). E Spell Shield (blocks a hostile effect, heals self on block — heal-shield.shield/cc-immunity atoms) and R On the Hunt (team MS/AS buff) are declared no_damage (defensive/utility — consistent scope; the E 'shield' is a spell shield, not an HP shield). No real gaps.
